summary: Three skiers rescued from the Difficult Creek drainage sidecountry off Aspen Mountain; one (40-year-old male) had a broken leg after the group stopped ~1,300 ft above the valley floor and lit a fire; Mountain Rescue Aspen 8-person team (incl. paramedic) plus 2-person evac team contacted them ~7:32 p.m.; patient stabilized and transported to Aspen Valley Hospital by ambulance.
location: Difficult Creek drainage, sidecountry off Aspen Mountain
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Date approximate: article states 'Wednesday afternoon' (2019-01-16 Wednesday-verified) + reverse-chron archive order; exact publish stamp not visible. PCSO press release via Aspen Daily News reprint. Call received ~4:55 p.m.; group skied sidecountry route off Aspen Mountain toward McFarland Lane, east of Aspen.
